# ChannelDoppler <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [3D Sound](Blitz3D-3D-Sound)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ChannelDoppler:Void channel:Int32, scale:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel` | In | Int32 | required | A channel handle from [EmitSound](EmitSound). |
| `scale` | In | Float32 | required | `1` (what a channel starts with) gets all of the shift of [ListenerDoppler](ListenerDoppler), `0` none. Below 0 is a runtime error. |

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Scales the doppler shift of one channel, on top of the one of the listener. A radio that the player carries moves with them and should not shift at all. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Differences

* A channel that is over is ignored. [GetChannelDoppler](GetChannelDoppler) tells the value.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
radio = EmitSound(music, camera)
ChannelDoppler radio, 0
```
